Hey there, I'm Gibran Mikail

Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer passionate about building modern, intuitive, and user-centered digital experiences.
⠀
I specialize in Frontend Development, UI/UX Design, working with technologies like React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and modern web frameworks. I enjoy turning ideas and designs into clean, responsive, and interactive applications.
⠀
My main focus is bridging the gap between design and development — creating products that are not only visually polished, but also functional, performant, and scalable. I’m constantly exploring new technologies, development practices, and creative approaches to build better digital products.
